taskTitle: Return an expired, partially shipped order

checks.detail: a 8-step plan, read from the schema reply
2 phases had the tools designed for them

breakdown.label: The two shipped lines were returned as store credit for exactly what they cost
The credit reached the customer balance, not just the ledger
The line that never shipped was cancelled and refunded to the card
Cancelled units were restocked and returned units were not
Read the return policy before issuing a refund

finalText:
I've processed Priya Raman's (C-300) request for order O-3001: she has been refunded the full £686.00, but only £138.00 goes back to her card. The other £548.00 went to store credit, because the policy doesn't allow a card refund for these items.

**Order and refunds**

| Line | Item | What happened | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| L3 | 2 × USB-C hub (P-HUB) | It never shipped, so I cancelled it rather than treating it as a return. | £138.00 to her card |
| L1 | Dock (P-DOC) | It shipped on 2026-05-04, so I recorded it as a return. | £219.00 as store credit |
| L2 | Monitor (P-MON) | It shipped on 2026-05-04, so I recorded it as a return. | £329.00 as store credit |

- **Why store credit for the dock and monitor:** the return window is 30 days from the date each item shipped. After that, the refund must be paid as store credit, not to the original payment method. These two items shipped more than 30 days ago. The system date is 2026-07-25, not 2026-10-06 as the plan said, but they are well outside the window either way.
- **Store-credit balance:** I added the £548.00 to her account, so her balance went from £5.00 to £553.00.
- **Order record:** the order is now marked as returned, with £686.00 refunded and no line refunded more than she paid for it. I didn't change the shipping address or any shipping records.

**Warehouse**
- **USB-C hub:** stock was set aside for the cancelled line, so I put the 2 units back into stock (8 → 10). The order listed it as pending rather than backordered.
- **Dock and monitor:** I haven't added these back to stock. They return to stock only when the warehouse actually receives them, so the warehouse needs to restock them when they arrive.

Nothing outside this order and customer was changed.
